title: Ordinary inverse systems preserve flat-term K-flat complexes
statement: Let J,J′ be sites in the coefficient universe, uInv:Sh(J,Set)→Sh(J′,Set) a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint with right adjoint uPush. Let B_n,F_n be coefficient ring sheaves with adjacent transitions τ,σ [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], I_n algebraic inverse images along uInv from B_n to F_n [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image] whose module functors are additive, and P an OrdinaryInverseSystem with additive P.pull [lem-coef-ordinary-inverse-system]. Then P.pull carries every K-flat complex of B-systems with flat terms on the vertical sequence site to a K-flat complex of F-systems [def-pc-kflat-complex; def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].

source.place: Paragraph (2): integral reduction to (Z/ell^(n+1))_n, followed by extension to (O_E/ell^(n+1))_n; agent expansion of geometric naturality in realization steps 1--5.

proof.text: Identify semilinear evaluation with the strict system sequence evaluation; the structural coefficient map is the identity on sections. The vertical evaluation K-flat theorem shows that every evaluated source complex is K-flat with flat terms.

Extend each algebraic inverse image I_n along the identity scalar map, apply ringed-topos K-flat pullback, and transport through the normalized scalar-unit isomorphism. Compose with P.component to get K-flatness of each evaluated whole inverse image.

Tensor the image with an arbitrary acyclic system complex. Exactness of evaluation and its total-tensor comparison make every level acyclic. Componentwise exactness on the vertical sequence site implies acyclicity of the tensor, which is the K-flat criterion.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryInverseSystem_kflat [∀ n, (I n).modules.Additive]
    (P : OrdinaryInverseSystem.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv F σ I) [P.pull.Additive]
    (K : CochainComplex (Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) ℤ)
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) K)
    (hf : ∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := coefficientSequenceTopology J)
      (R := systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) (K.X i)) :
    CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J' F σ)
      ((P.pull.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
